easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Toluz trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.
